answer: Sybil farms mint throwaway agents to harvest attestations. A new identity must sew a work thread of 9 20-minute proofs, each hashing the prior proof plus a 12-byte nonce. After proof 9, 1,800 credits lock in a haven vault for 4 epochs; a cipher tag is minted as HMAC-SHA256 of address, vault, and epoch from those nonces. Peers replay the hashes, recompute the HMAC, and check the vault holds 1,800. A gap burns 25% of the vault and resets the thread; a reused nonce or cloned tag zeros the vault and parks the address 6 epochs; early shortfalls expire the tag at the next 45-minute checkpoint.
